name: Bizppurio Messaging
description: Bizppurio SMS/LMS and Kakao Alimtalk delivery plugin.

settings.title: Bizppurio Messaging Settings
settings.description: Manage Bizppurio integration and delivery settings.

test_mode.label: Test Mode
test_mode.hint: In test mode, messages are sent to the Bizppurio test domain. Turn it off to send via the production domain.
test_mode.account_notice: We recommend using separate Bizppurio accounts for testing and production.

settings.live_mode_warning_body: Test mode is off — real customers will receive messages and delivery costs will be billed. Keep test mode on during inspection.

api.title: API Integration
api.description: Credentials shared by the sending system and the Kakao management system.

sending.title: Sending Settings
sending.description: Sender information used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

bizppurio_id.label: Bizppurio ID
bizppurio_id.hint: The Bizppurio account ID used for both sending and Kakao management.

password.label: Bizppurio Module Password
password.hint: Enter the Bizppurio module password. (Bizppurio console > Module integration settings > Change module password)

connection_check.label: Connection Check
connection_check.hint: Verify that the saved ID and password are valid. (Applies after saving)
connection_check.success: Authentication verified. The ID and password are correct.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: Request the API key from Bizppurio customer support along with your account ID.

sender_number.label: Sender Number
sender_number.hint: The sender phone number used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

sender_key.label: Alimtalk Sender Profile Key
sender_key.hint: The 40-character sender profile key used for alimtalk delivery and template requests.

report.hint: Bizppurio pushes delivery results (URL PUSH) to this address after sending. Register the address below with the Bizppurio business team (or the report settings in the console).
report.note: Once registered, delivery results are recorded automatically. Before registration, only the send request is confirmed and final results are not updated.
report.copied: Report receiving address copied to clipboard.

preparation.intro: To send SMS and Kakao alimtalk, complete the preparations below in the Bizppurio console first.
preparation.kakao_channel: Create a KakaoTalk business channel and register a sender profile.
preparation.kakao_template: Alimtalk templates are composed and submitted for inspection in the admin notification settings (Bizppurio tab).
preparation.kakao_apikey: Request an API key from customer support.

binding.variables_hint: Available variables (click to insert at the cursor)

banner.not_ready: Required delivery settings are not complete.
banner.test_mode: Test mode — no real messages are sent.

dispatch_result.sent_content_hint: Alimtalk is sent with the approved template content, which may differ from the body above.

template.tab_guide: Compose an alimtalk template per notification and request inspection. Once Kakao approves it, alimtalk is sent automatically. SMS fallback and SMS-only delivery are also configured here.

form.rejected_banner: This template was rejected. Review the reasons below, edit, and request inspection again.
form.sender_profile_hint: Inspection requests use the sender profile key saved in the plugin settings.
form.name: Template name
form.image_hint: jpg/png · up to 500KB · width ≥500px · 2:1 ratio (the URL is filled automatically after upload)
form.header_hint: Optional header shown above the body (up to 16 characters)
form.item_list_hint: At least 2 and up to 10 items. (title ≤6 chars, description ≤23 chars)
form.requested_toast: Inspection requested. Alimtalk delivery starts once approved.

sms.hint: This body is shared by SMS fallback and SMS-only delivery. #{variables} are substituted at send time.

cancel_approval.warning: Cancelling approval of '{name}' immediately stops alimtalk delivery for this notification. (SMS fallback and SMS-only delivery continue per the SMS settings.) Alimtalk resumes only after you edit, request inspection again, and get approved.
cancel_approval.done_toast: Approval cancelled. Edit and request inspection again.

manage.guide: Manage the Bizppurio template status of every notification at a glance. Composing and requesting inspection work the same as in the notification settings screen.
manage.empty_hint: Templates appear here once you compose an alimtalk template or configure SMS in the admin notification settings (Bizppurio tab).

delete.warning: Delete the Bizppurio template settings of '{name}'. The Kakao-side template is deleted together only when it is in a deletable state (registered/rejected).
delete.done_db_only: Template settings deleted. The Kakao-side template remains due to its state.

readiness.title: The settings below are required to use alimtalk templates
readiness.note: Enter the items above in the Settings tab to compose templates and request inspection. Real delivery requires turning off test mode and an approved template.
